blocks.x: He still got a little bit left on the tape. And trombone players, they haven't he got trombone players?

Yeah, we had Eddie Pearson. Eddie Pearson, Nelson. Those were outstanding people for me. Jim was always a good trombone player. Jim Robson was always a good trombone player. You know where you take him? Faking or reading? He always was a great man. What about piano players? Piano players? We had Louis Given. You ever heard of him? I knew him. Alegrat Alexander. You ever heard of him?
Heard of him. Talked to him on the phone. I never had met him.
Yeah? I didn't know he'd been gone so long until I knew you were talking.
I might have him mixed up with somebody else. We had Walter Pigeon.
Miss Kimball. You ever heard of him? Yeah, I don't know. Yeah.
Great person. And drums. I had drummers, eh?
The drums we had. Lewis and Paul Barbaran always had been outstanding drummers this time. Bass class. We didn't talk about that. Chester, Cleo, or Walcox. We had Ransom.
Ransom Nolan, I met him once. Yeah.

But Walcox, I don't know from him either. Yeah, he was from Xavier College, but he was around with different bands. Big bands, you know. Big bands, Manuel? Yeah. The way they played, they played with anybody, you know. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
